summary: Negative whole-second millisecond timestamps incorrectly become the preceding second with 1,000,000,000 nanoseconds. The fix adjusts seconds only for a negative remainder and uses zero nanoseconds for exact seconds. Blocked: the added test naive::datetime::tests::test_datetime_from_timestamp_millis does not expose this incorrect representation. Its negative case, -2208936075000, still round-trips and formats as expected because this revision accepts the excess nanoseconds and formatting normalizes them. No other detecting upstream test was found among calls to this function. No tests were executed.
